mapper.select: SELECT salesman_name AS salesmanName, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN is_delay = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayCount, ROUND(IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN is_delay = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 2) AS delayRate, ROUND(AVG(collection_delay_minutes), 2) AS avgDelayMinutes FROM t_collection_record WHERE DATE(expected_collection_time) >= #{startDate} AND DATE(expected_collection_time) <= #{endDate} AND salesman_name IS NOT NULL AND salesman_name != '' GROUP BY salesman_name ORDER BY totalCount DESC
